limitations: The STEP delivery contains only head-neck and torso B-Rep source bodies; it is not a complete assembly.
The OBJ delivery is a visual reference mannequin and does not add armor or engineering systems.
No armor, wings, joints, hands, legs, propulsion, fuel, control, structural, aerodynamic or safety validation is represented by these files.
The current browser modeler does not render raw STEP B-Rep; the files remain preserved source references until a verified translation workflow is added.
This baseline is for digital geometry review only and must not be used as flight, manufacturing, fit or safety authorization.
